name: Renaissance Monumental Ensembles of Úbeda and Baeza
description: Úbeda and Baeza are two small hilltop towns in Andalusia, in Spain's Jaén province, set on a ridge between the Guadalquivir and Guadalimar rivers. Their street plans go back to Moorish times, but both were reshaped in the 16th century with elegant Renaissance palaces and churches. Wandering them, you see how Italian ideas arrived in Spain and later travelled to Latin America.
